breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt specified a time domain of t in [0, 1.0] but requested an output at T=1.1, which is outside this domain. The ground truth corrected this by setting the final time to T=1.0. The agent's generated specification correctly identifies this and consistently uses T=1.0 throughout the instructions, stating 'The temporal domain is t in [0, 1.0]' and 'Compute the numerical solution u(x, T) at the final time T = 1.0'.
